title: Kusanagi Nene — I'm Used To Setup Now〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Rental Room in Tokyo

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Let's do an angle test in five. Sound good?

rows.Speaker: Film Crew
rows.Line:
Yes, once the lights are all set!
Let's also have the cast take their places!

rows.Speaker: Film Crew
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Everyone's hard at work like always...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's been about two weeks since they let us join the crew...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's obvious that they're all doing their best to make this film as good as possible.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which explains the tension in the air.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (All the while...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Rui's been getting in some hands-on learning with them...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Rui has such a serious look on his face!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I still can't believe he's working as the director's assistant now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well, he is our director☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And he sounded really happy when he came over to tell us about how he was gonna get to learn firsthand about directing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ...and starting tomorrow, I'll be working alongside Mr. Ohara as his assistant.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Chances to learn about directing a film like this don't come around often...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I plan on absorbing as much as I can from him.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He did say he's been wanting to learn more about directing films, so I'm glad for him. But...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can't let him leave me behind. This really is an amazing opportunity, so I should also learn as much as I can about being a crew member.)

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: Kusanagi, Otori, do you both have a minute? I need you two to help lay the lunches out on that table over there.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, okay! Be right there!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There we go...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think that's all the lunches.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! But that was a lot of boxes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm still blown away every time by how many lunches we need to feed all the people working on this crew.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: With these and all the drinks we have to carry around... I'm starting to feel a lot stronger.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Nene, you're so buff now☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Buff...? I'm not sure how to feel about that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, getting to work behind the scenes like this...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's giving us a chance to see just how much work there is to go around even for just one film.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That includes the lunches. I didn't realize they do their best to not serve the same thing every day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And how there's a trick to stacking up the lunches so it's easy for everyone to take what they want!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. They seem like really minor things, but each one helps in a small way to make the film better.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Helps in a small way...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I guess that also applies to shows.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I remember my brothers saying, “It's our job to facilitate an environment that allows the cast to focus on their shows.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I feel like they must have been working really hard to support us, just like the crew of this film!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I see your point...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was so caught up in my own problems until now that I never really had a chance to think about everyone who helps us behind the scenes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Getting to work as part of this crew has started to give me a greater appreciation for just how much help we've received.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too!
I'm gonna thank my brothers the next chance I get!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, let's try not to forget what they've done for us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'll probably meet a lot more people moving forward as I do more shows.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (In order to make the most of their support...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to keep growing as an actress.)
